sentiment: The hands that carried us through the dark leave, and we keep asking what progress is for — maybe slower things, made carefully, hold longer.

stories.title: Margaret Hamilton has died
stories.summary: The woman whose software carried Apollo home has left. Her work was written by hand, checked twice, and it held — a reminder that care, not speed, is what keeps people safe.

stories.title: “Math 2.0” will need to value mathematical progress more holistically
stories.summary: Terence Tao asking what we should even count as progress. When the output accelerates, the harder question is what is worth keeping — and why.

stories.title: Living off-grid: Hundred Rabbits
stories.summary: A pair who chose to build slowly, on a boat, off the network. Proof that deliberately smaller and slower can be a form of strength rather than retreat.
